All files and new documentation content on our official documentation repository. It has been redesigned with a General Documentation section that will be populated with all the new content created for this Catalyst process.
(A) A wallet-side code update to detach more from wallet the schema and documentation generation to allow all milestones workflows: All API documentation HTML files were published as a standalone snapshot for this milestone. We kindly offer also a milestone "zero" snapshot for comparison purposes. Remember that you can also access the latest hosted in-wallet API documentation here
(B) Redesign relevant descriptions with the creation of markdown generator helpers: Specifically all Inline Scripting Language functions or "inline macros" definitions were completely redesigned as part of the schema itself, and a new markdown documentation system creates the new descriptions based on function names, arguments and types. A new namespace system has been introduced for them as well.
(C) Add missing or improve descriptions on some functions, properties and definitions: More than 525 references on GCScript functions in schema has been updated with missing titles, descriptions and types based on targetted schemas, fixing 525 references in documentation as well. Also specific descriptions, types and titles has been added to some properties (and referenced definitions). Some examples: Condition Provider, Wallet Setup Layer, all Inline Macro References, etc.. Added the missing language reserved return() and fail() macro definitions.
(D) Optional miscellaneous schema improvements derived from the process, like refactors, definition changes: All typos were fixed on descriptions and other parts of the schema, some property names were fixed after this like submitTxs.mode.sequential option. Fixed some misleading descriptions like with script.return.mode options. Introduced a new fine-grained syntax error detection for Inline Macros to allow for better macr
